descriptions.job-05mctux:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission 

You drive the day-to-day coordination of complex audits, examinations, and remediation tracking across Information Security, ICT risk, TPRM, and operational resilience. You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of evidence collection, ensuring every request, decision, and finding remains perfectly traceable and audit-ready. By supporting domain owners and executing a highly controlled intake process, you will ensure our leadership has timely, accurate information for critical decisions and risk escalation.

What you’ll do

  • Engagement & Evidence Workflow Management: Operate the daily intake process for new engagements and evidence requests. Coordinate directly with domain and control owners to collect, organize, and quality-check evidence for completeness and version control against agreed internal deadlines.
  • Audit Portfolio Administration: Maintain the centralized audit calendar, engagement register, and findings inventory. Ensure precise tracking of scope, owners, requests, dependencies, and current status across all regulatory and internal assurance activities.
  • Documentation & Auditor-Facing Preparation: Prepare high-quality evidence packs, response trackers, meeting agendas, action logs, and status reporting. Ensure all submissions to auditors, regulators, and management are accurate, secure, and properly approved by domain owners.
  • Remediation Tracking & Control Integration: Track remediation plans and final closure evidence, identifying overdue or incomplete actions early. Partner with control-testing teams to coordinate the reuse of relevant evidence and proactively escalate delivery risks to the Audit Management Lead.
  • Process Optimization & Tooling: Administer the agreed workflow within existing GRC, ticketing, and collaboration tools. Consistently apply the audit-governance process while identifying safe opportunities to automate repetitive administrative work and reduce avoidable evidence rework.

Who you are

  • 4–7 years of relevant experience in audit coordination, technology risk, information security GRC, regulatory compliance, control assurance, or structured programme management.
  • Proven track record of managing competing deadlines, handling sensitive information with sound judgement, and confidently following up with cross-functional stakeholders to drive action.
  • Strong understanding of audit evidence standards, control documentation, and the findings management lifecycle within a regulated environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or third-party risk management is highly beneficial.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and written communication in professional English (German is beneficial), with the ability to maintain highly reliable records and response trackers.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About Bybit and this role

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with teams across many countries working around the clock. Our global workplace footprint includes rented offices with local administrative support, rented offices without local administrative support, and co-working locations.
The Head of Global Workplace Operations manages and develops local team leaders across this footprint. You will ensure every location is safe, well run, cost-effective, and a place people want to come to work, maintaining consistent standards while adapting delivery to local needs and the level of on-site support available.
Mission: Give every Bybit employee a safe, productive, and welcoming workplace, run efficiently across every rented office and co-working location.

Global workplace footprint

  • Rented offices with local administrative support: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Malaysia, Indonesia, Georgia, Austria, and others offices across APAC and EMEA.
  • Rented offices without local administrative support: Turkey, Brazil, Lithuania, and the Netherlands.
  • Co-working locations: Kazakhstan, Paris, Bahrain, Bangalore, and other cities across APAC and EMEA.

Key responsibilities

Office strategy and real estate

  • Own the global workplace strategy and space plan across rented offices and co-working locations, in partnership with Finance and business leaders.
  • Lead office openings, moves, expansions, and fit-outs, on time and on budget.
  • Support lease negotiations and renewals with Finance and Legal.
  • Use occupancy data and employee feedback to plan space and design better offices.

Facilities and site operations

  • Oversee day-to-day workplace operations through local team leaders: facilities, maintenance, front desk, mail, supplies, and amenities, as applicable to each location and operating model.
  • Set and enforce consistent workplace standards across all sites, with clear accountability for local team leaders and service arrangements tailored to each location.
  • Provide spaces that meet diverse needs, such as prayer, wellness, and parent rooms.
  • Enable local team leaders to support internal events and visits at each location, in partnership with the Internal Events team.

Health, safety, and security

  • Own workplace health and safety, including local regulatory compliance at each site.
  • Partner with Security and IT on physical security, access control, and visitor management.
  • Lead business continuity and emergency response plans for every office.

Vendors, budget, and team

  • Manage facilities vendors and service contracts, with clear service levels.
  • Own the workplace budget and drive cost discipline.
  • Manage, coach, and develop local team leaders across regions, setting clear objectives, decision rights, and performance expectations. Coordinate local administrators and facilities staff where available, and central support functions, vendors, or co-working providers where on-site support is limited.
  • Track and report on cost, service quality, and employee satisfaction with the workplace.

What you bring

  • Strong knowledge of workplace health and safety and local regulations.
  • Track record of managing vendors, contracts, and budgets.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with workplace tools (e.g., space planning, visitor management, or service request systems).
  • Facilities or safety certification (e.g., IFMA, NEBOSH).
  • Arabic or Mandarin is a plus.

How you lead

  • Operator. You run sites well, anticipate problems, and fix them fast.
  • Service mindset. You design the workplace around the people who use it.
  • Cost-conscious. You spend wisely and get value from every vendor.
  • Safety-first. You never compromise on the safety of our people.
  • Global mindset. You respect local cultures while keeping standards consistent.
  • Hands-on leader. You stay connected to local team leaders, are visible across the global workplace footprint, and lead your team by example.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

Blockdaemon is looking for a hands-on Site Reliability Engineer to join our Security team and take ownership of the cloud infrastructure that our security posture depends on. You'll work across our full cloud footprint, building and maintaining the Terraform and Ansible that define our environments, running production Kubernetes (GKE), and owning the network layer, including Cloudflare, Tailscale, and egress proxy infrastructure that controls how traffic moves in and out of our systems.

You'll have direct influence over how our cloud environments are structured, secured, and automated, and your work will have a visible, immediate impact on our risk posture and operational resilience.

Your Impact

  • Own the design, reliability, and hardening of multi cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm) as the source of truth for how environments are provisioned and configured

  • Own network security architecture: egress proxy configuration, traffic segmentation, and outbound control across cloud environments

  • Manage and evolve our Cloudflare footprint (DNS, WAF, edge security, traffic routing) and API gateway layer (Zuplo)

  • Operate and secure Tailscale as our zero trust network access layer, including access policy design and rollout to new environments

  • Manage on-call rotation and incident response for infrastructure and network layer issues, driving root cause analysis and durable fixes rather than one-off patches

  • Practical experience with Tailscale or another zero trust network access solution

Great stories start with extraordinary people.

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

Story inspires science. Science makes story real.

Your Story

We're looking for a Creative Associate who can turn ideas into reality, fast. You'll work directly with Jason Carman, our founder, across both his companies Story and Wizard. Jason has more ideas than hands. Your job is to get those ideas out of his head and into the world: a deck by the end of the day, a video brief for the team, a social media campaign or post set up and then launched.

You'll be Jason's creative multi-tool. One day you're in a string of meetings with him, capturing what matters and tracking every creative deliverable across both companies. The next, you're probing him with questions until a half-formed idea becomes a clear pitch, then finding the right people to make it happen and seeing it through every round of notes to the finish. When Jason isn't in the room, you're his creative eyes, ears, and brain.

It's also not for the faint of heart. If you dislike multitasking, this isn't for you. If holding a dozen projects in your head at once sounds like fun, read on.

What You'll Own

  • Make the decks. Turn rough thinking into sharp, beautiful decks, fast, using AI-assisted design tools like Claude Design and Figma.

  • Pull ideas out of Jason's head. Probe with questions and ideas until the thinking is clear, then capture it in a deck, a brief, or a plan.

  • Get ideas moving. For any idea, whether it's a video, a campaign, or anything else, set it up, find the team, execute, handle notes, and close it out.

  • Track every creative deliverable. Keep a clear view of what's in flight across Story and Wizard, who owns it, and what's next.

  • Be Jason's right hand in the room. Join meetings across projects, capture what matters, and follow through so nothing drops.

  • Hold the context. Keep many projects, people, and threads in your head at once, and connect the dots between them.

You're the Right Person If

  • You're early in your career but ready to take on far more than your title suggests. Exceptional work matters more to us than years on a resume.

  • You work extremely hard and learn incredibly fast.

  • You genuinely believe in what Story and Wizard are building. This will be your life's work while you're here.

  • You love art, movies, design, and business.

  • You have strong taste, and you can judge creative work from several perspectives.

  • You're a good writer with real opinions about copy, and you understand marketing.

  • You're a people person who's at ease with engineers, creatives, and everyone in between.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and love juggling many things at once.

  • You're fluent in AI tools, especially Claude Design, and comfortable in Figma.

  • You love mood boards, Pinterest, and collecting references.

  • This isn't a video editing role, though editing experience is a plus. You'll mostly create with Wizard, which makes that part easy.

What Sets You Apart

You're a force multiplier. You make the person you work with faster and better. Give you a messy idea in the morning and there's a clear, beautiful deck by the end of the day.

You don't wait for permission. You don't wait on a designer, an editor, or a producer to get something started. You pick up the tools, make a first version, and bring in help when it's needed.

You have taste, and opinions to match. You can tell good creative from great, explain why, and still see it from the audience's point of view, not just your own.

You're relentlessly optimistic. You bring energy to every meeting and treat a hard problem as a fun one.

You close the loop. You remember what was promised, follow up without being asked, and see every project through to the finish.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $80,000 – $100,000. Your final offer will depend on your experience, skills and level.

How to Apply

Share a portfolio, decks, or other work that shows your taste and how you think. A strong body of work counts more than years of experience. Finalists will complete a short work sample: we'll hand you a raw brain dump and ask for a deck by the end of the day.
